question: Should OpenClaw permanently support this Discord-only subagent progress UX, including its seven-field configuration, channel lifecycle adapter, requester message metadata, and persisted cleanup marker?
rationale: The change establishes new public configuration and plugin lifecycle contracts whose long-term support and restart semantics require owner intent beyond code-level correctness.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Approve the direction after both P1 races are fixed and exact-head live plus upgrade and restart proof is posted.

options.title: Require a narrower seam
options.body: Keep the Discord UX goal but redesign it around a smaller owner-approved lifecycle and configuration surface.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Do not add Discord-specific subagent progress to the supported OpenClaw surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Approve the direction after both P1 races are fixed and exact-head live plus upgrade and restart proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest recent history across both the Discord plugin boundary and subagent lifecycle state affected by this product choice.
